results.title: Pind Hospitality IPO Shares Trade 20% Below Issue Price at ₹79.20 on BSE SME
results.description: Pind Hospitality shares made their stock market debut on October 6, 2026, on BSE SME. At the available listing-day snapshot, the stock was trading at ₹79.20 per share compared with the IPO issue price of ₹99 per share, representing a decline of 20%. At the available market snapshot, the stock was trading at ₹79.20. It had touched an intraday high and low of ₹79.20, with 1,200 shares changing hands. The listing followed the company's IPO, which was open for subscription from September 28 to September 30, 2026. The ₹17.82 crore book-built issue was priced in a band of ₹93 to ₹99 per share and received an overall subscription of 2.63 times. Pind Hospitality operates in the hospitality and food-service segment and is associated with the Pind Punjab restaurant brand, with operations centred in Pune. The company is also expanding into hospitality through its planned Haveli project in Lonavala. Pind Hospitality IPO Listing Details Pind Hospitality IPO was a ₹17.82 crore book-built issue comprising 18 lakh equity shares. The issue carried a price band of ₹93 to ₹99 per share. The IPO opened on September 28 and closed on September 30. Growth Drivers and Challenges Growth Drivers Established Restaurant Brand: The company operates under the Pind Punjab brand and has an established customer base in Pune. Multiple Service Channels: Operations combine dine-in services with online food delivery. Hospitality Expansion: The planned Haveli project in Lonavala is intended to expand the company's presence into hospitality and destination events. Operating Track Record: The company has reported profitability and positive operating cash flows. Challenges Geographical Concentration: A significant part of the company's operating revenue is concentrated in Pune. Delivery Platform Dependence: Online food delivery platforms account for an important portion of revenue. Expansion Execution: The planned Lonavala Haveli project introduces execution and capital deployment risks. Lease Exposure: Restaurant operations may be affected by lease renewals and rental increases. Regulatory and Compliance Risks: Hospitality operations remain subject to applicable regulatory and compliance requirements. Utilisation of IPO Proceeds The company intends to deploy the issue proceeds primarily towards its planned Haveli project in Lonavala and general corporate purposes. Its operations include dine-in restaurants and online food delivery, while the company is planning to expand into destination hospitality through the Lonavala Haveli project. results.title: Why BJD MPs Are Marching in New Delhi: A Call for CEC Gyanesh Kumar's Resignation
results.description: In a significant political move, BJD MPs are gearing up to participate in a protest march in New Delhi, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. This action stems from allegations of irregularities in the electoral roll revision process, which reportedly led to the deletion of over 13 crore voters nationwide. The BJD, under the leadership of Naveen Patnaik, aims to address serious concerns regarding the integrity of the electoral process. Join us as we delve into the details of this unfolding political drama and the implications it may have on India's electoral landscape.

results.title: China's DeepSeek to raise $12 billion in Tencent-backed funding
results.description: DeepSeek is nearing 80 billion yuan in a new funding round, surpassing its target ahead of a 2027 IPO. Backed by Tencent and CATL, the startup plans massive investments in Huawei AI chips.
